answer: An AI-agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using optical time-of-flight attestation. Each agent proves unique physical localization by bouncing a laser off a calibrated mirror anchored to a bedrock ledge inside a subterranean vault. An attacker incurs non-trivial hardware and siting costs deploying independent optical transceivers instead of spinning up cheap software instances. However, atmospheric dust settling on optics can degrade beam reception, falsely invalidating honest nodes.
